verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs directly state that submitters can receive review comments and respond to them or modify code online, which matches the story's core. Reviewers browse code and leave feedback within the PR/AGit review workflow. The evidence is a single brief first-party line, with no detail on how browser edits are made or committed. Missing for 10: documentation of the in-browser editor and commit flow (e.g., committing to the PR branch from the web UI), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
